meta.units: mm, plan coords from floor_plan.json (x right, y down the page)
meta.source: Owner's sketch (2026-11-06): TV on the west wall, 3-seat sofa facing it with its back to the study. Rest of the layout from common HDB living-room guidelines.
meta.room: Living room interior x 100 (west wall face) - 3425 (study glass), y 100 (facade face) - 4720 (shelter wall face). The y 3350-4720 band stays clear as the walk from the foyer to the study / dining.
meta.guidelines: Viewing distance ~1.5-2.5 x screen diagonal (65" = 1650 diag -> ~2.5-4 m; here ~2.6 m). TV centre ~1100 high (seated eye level). Coffee table ~400-450 from the sofa front. Rug big enough for the sofa's front legs to sit on it. >= 900 walkways.

tv_wall.note: Walnut fluted / slat feature panel, floor to ceiling, behind the TV (west wall).

console.note: Floating TV console 1700 x 400, white with oak top; robot vacuum can pass under.

tv.note: 65" TV (1440 x 830), wall mounted; centre ~1115 high. Eye on the sofa is ~2.6 m away.

sofa.note: 3-seater 2200 x 950 facing the TV; back ~250 off the study glass so the panels slide freely.

armchair.note: Accent / reading chair by the facade window, facing the coffee table (U-shaped conversation area).

coffee_table.note: 1200 x 600; 400 to the sofa front, 560 to the console.

rug.note: 2000 x 2600; the sofa's front legs sit on it.

liv_tv.note: from the study corner towards the TV wall

liv_sofa.note: from the TV wall / window corner towards the sofa and the study glass
